# FQ-SORKIN-READOUT-CLASS-QM208

The polynomial family is supplied. New Lean proves the universal I3 polynomial identity and vanishing for all triples iff quartic coefficient is zero; one zero triple is insufficient. The QZeta12 norm coordinates of source vPlus/vMinus are computed using the actual basis multiplication/conjugation. R_AB has Galois comparison difference8B, so invariance is B=0 in that basis. Equal embedding weights use different coordinates and must not be identified with A=B; the source A=B=1 example produces11 versus3.

Supported: Universal I3(alpha*t²+beta*t⁴)=12*beta*abc(a+b+c), hence universal vanishing iff beta=0. Exact Q(zeta12) control norms (7,±4) give R_AB invariance iff B=0; no full positivity-cone classification is inferred.

Remaining: Formalize the embedding-weight/basis-coordinate conversion and full rational readout positivity cone. Polynomial restriction and amplitude addition are admitted, and this is not a classification of all readouts.
